bugs.error_message: Raw CSS (site-footer and compare-grid rules) displayed as visible text at the top of Patho_Week6_Interactive_Guide.html
bugs.root_cause: The guide was assembled by concatenating a head slice of the Week 2 guide with new body files. The head slice ended with </style>, and the new body file began with additional CSS rules, so those rules landed outside the stylesheet and the browser rendered them as page text.
bugs.fix: Removed the stray </style> at the seam so the appended CSS sits inside the single <style> block. Verified with a parser check: exactly one <style>/</style> pair, no CSS after the closing tag.

bugs.error_message: Hero section (kicker, H1, lede, chips, example) rendered completely blank on page 1 when the guide was printed or exported to PDF
bugs.root_cause: Entrance animation .fade sets opacity:0 and relies on a CSS @keyframes to fade in. Print and headless PDF rendering snapshot the page before animations complete, so the elements stayed at opacity:0 and printed blank. Screen rendering was fine, which is why it was missed until page 1 of a PDF export was actually inspected.
bugs.fix: Added @media print{.fade{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;animation:none!important}} so animated-in content is forced visible on paper. Verified by re-rendering page 1 via headless Chrome.
